note: Ameriabank: its lending terms for unsecured credit cards (edition 69, effective 7 July 2026) charge a VISA Classic or Mastercard Standard card 21% a year in drams (15% to 21% when scored, written at its top); its card rates and fees (edition 46, effective 7 July 2026) charge no annual service fee on a card issued as a credit card by scoring, the way a card is ordered online.

sources.title: Ameriabank, Retail Lending Terms and Conditions (Credit Cards not secured with property), edition 69 (effective 7 July 2026)
sources.said: Retail Lending Terms and Conditions ... Edition 69 ... Effective date: July 07, 2026 ... VISA Classic/Master Card Standard ... AMD: 21% ... the nominal interest rate for AMD denominated loans may be 15% - 21%

sources.title: Ameriabank, Card Rates and Fees, edition 46 (effective 7 July 2026)
sources.said: Edition 46 ... Effective date: July 7, 2026 ... In case of scoring-based lending, either Visa Classic or Mastercard Standard card is issued as a credit card, irrespective of the approved loan amount. There is no annual service fee in this case.
